openapi.title: API documentation
openapi.settings: Edit cluster Metadata in the existing cluster editor. OpenApi.Enabled selects visibility; OpenApi.Settings contains JSON using the YarpOpenApi cluster options. Save or restore a snapshot, then reload this page.
openapi.disabled: API documentation is disabled. Enable Gateway:OpenApi and configure documentation access in the gateway host.
openapi.split: In Split mode, documentation is available on the Dashboard listener. API calls use the Proxy listener; interactive requests from the documentation listener may be unavailable.
